name: C. R. Swart
contribution: A South African politician who served as the last governor-general of the Union of South Africa from 1959 to 1961 and the first state president of the Republic of South Africa from 1961 to 1967.
legacy: The highest peak in the remote Prince Edward Islands was called State President this person Peak, before it was renamed Mascarin Peak in 2003.

checks.lead: Charles Robberts Swart  (5 December 1894 – 16 July 1982), nicknamed "Blackie", was a South African politician who served as the last governor-general of the Union of South Africa from 1959 to 1961 and the first state president of the Republic of South Africa from 1961 to 1967.
